_comment: Šablóna Veo b-roll segmentu. Skopíruj a vyplň na každý segment (hook-a/hook-b/telo/cta). Píš po anglicky. B-roll = ŽIADNY text v zábere.

shot.scene: where we are — location/setting in detail
shot.subject: who/what is in frame
shot.action: what happens across the clip, beat by beat
shot.camera: movement + angle + focal feel (e.g. handheld 35mm slow push-in)

product_fidelity: Exact product description — shape, material, color, details. Copy this identically into every segment so the product stays consistent (no keyframe reference is used).

continuity.setting: shared environment for telo+cta (keep identical across telo and cta)
continuity.grade: color grade / look (keep identical across segments meant to cut together)
continuity.in_point: what the first frame looks like (for clean cut from previous segment)
continuity.out_point: what the last frame looks like (leads into next segment)

negative: no on-screen text, no captions, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no UI elements, no brand names rendered in frame
_extension_note: Pre telo > 8 s: druhý súbor telo-2.json s task='extend', continue_from='telo-1 last second', a 'action' opisuje len ďalších +7 s pohybu (nie celú scénu odznova). Max 20× → ~148 s.
